name: discovery_planning
content: Generate a discovery plan for parameter '{parameter_name}' that can be discovered using available tools.
1. **bash** - Execute bash commands (system info, file operations, read-only)
2. **curl** - HTTP requests (API health checks, fetch data)
Task: Determine if this parameter can be discovered using these tools WITHOUT user input.
"reasoning": "why this approach or why cannot discover",
- can_discover=true ONLY if parameter can be found using bash or curl
- method: Choose the most appropriate tool for this parameter
- command: Exact bash or curl command (must be read-only and safe)
- expected_confidence: 0.8-0.9 for high certainty, 0.7-0.8 for medium
If parameter cannot be discovered autonomously, set can_discover=false.

variables.name: parameter_name
variables.description: The technical name of the parameter to discover

variables.name: description
variables.description: Description of what this parameter represents

variables.name: user_message
variables.description: The user's original message or request

variables.name: context_info
variables.description: Additional context including tool purpose and known parameters
examples:
Tool: system_diagnostics
Tool Purpose: Gather system information

Already Known Parameters:
- os_type: linux

metadata.description: Generates discovery plans to autonomously find parameter values using bash or curl
metadata.author: MagicianV2-ProgressiveElicitation
metadata.changelog: Initial version for Phase 2.2 autonomous discovery
